title: Zephyr: Rule 5 decompression
description: Implement Rule 5 OSCORE decompression in Zephyr C. Acceptance: decompresses to original headers, cross-validates.
notes: Implemented the Zephyr C inverse for current Rule 5 after explicit ownership clearance on accumulated SCHC C files. The decoder now consumes exactly the canonical 174-bit residue (hop, fe80::/64 IIDs, 4-bit port suffixes, CoAP fixed fields), rejects both nonzero padding bits, validates TKL/token availability and exactly one RFC 8613-valid OSCORE option before writing output, enforces the 22,554-byte compressed profile maximum and caller capacity, reconstructs IPv6/UDP lengths and checksum, and leaves output unchanged on every reachable failure. Refactored the shared OSCORE parser to validate split CoAP fixed/tail input so compression and decompression use one strict option grammar without allocating a packet-sized scratch buffer. Added isolated lichen/tests/schc_rule5_decompress coverage for the canonical shared Python-oracle vector, independently encoded fields plus byte-exact recompression, every truncated residue length 1..22, both padding bits, reserved TKL, missing/absent/invalid/duplicate OSCORE, empty payload marker, undersized output, and exact 22,554 acceptance / 22,555 atomic rejection. Validation: strict host build succeeded; UBSan ctest passed 1/1; Rule5 compression regression passed after parser refactor; Python test_rule5.py 14 passed; isolated Rust rule5_decompression 8 passed; focused cppcheck and git diff --check clean.
close_reason: Canonical atomic Zephyr C Rule 5 OSCORE decompression implemented and cross-validated against shared Python/Rust vectors.
